desc:
In pursuance to our letter ref. no.  NFL/BSE/50/2026-27, we hereby inform you that the Borrowing and Investment Committee of Namdev Finvest Limited (Formerly Known as Namdev Finvest Private Limited) ('the Company') has passed below mentioned agenda items at their meeting held today i.e. Wednesday, 26th day of August 2026, to raise funds by issuance of non- convertible debt securities on private placement basis in one or more tranches to eligible investor(s).:-
1. Considered and approved matters related to private placement of up to 7500 (Seven Thousand Five Hundred) Non-Convertible Debentures ('NCDs' or 'Debentures'), having a face value of INR 1,00,000/- (Indian Rupees One Lakh) each and an aggregate nominal value of upto INR 75,00,00,000
